**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

§ 14.1 is a real and substantially robust insurance clause — CGL $2M, fidelity $10M, workers' compensation as mandated by law with $500k employer's liability, all-risk property, A-rated carriers, 30 days' notice of change/cancellation, and certificates at signing and annually on request. Two fallback elements are genuinely absent from the whole document (searches for "errors and omissions"/"professional liability" and "cyber"/"privacy liability" returned nothing).

The cure is a single insert as a new item 5 in the existing § 14.1(A) schedule, carrying only the two still-missing fallback elements: E&O of $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of $2,000,000. Because § 14.1(B) already ties carrier ratings, notice and certificates to "the coverage required by this Section," no collateral edits or duplicated mechanics were needed, and I did not volunteer the higher preferred amounts or CGL split limits.
